defmodule FileServer do
  @moduledoc "Secure file serving module with path validation"
  @base_dir "/var/www/static"

  def serve_file(request_path) do
    with {:ok, decoded} <- uri_decode(request_path),
         {:ok, normalized} <- normalize_path(decoded),
         {:ok, safe_path} <- validate_path(normalized),
         {:ok, content} <- read_file(safe_path) do
      {:ok, content}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp uri_decode(path) do
    try do
      {:ok, URI.decode(path)}
    rescue
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_encoding}
    end
  end

  defp normalize_path(path) do
    # Remove consecutive slashes and normalize
    normalized = path
    |> String.replace(~r/\/+/, "/")
    |> remove_dot_segments()
    {:ok, normalized}
  end

  defp remove_dot_segments(path) do
    segments = String.split(path, "/")
    resolve_segments(segments, [])
    |> Enum.reverse()
    |> Enum.join("/")
  end

  defp resolve_segments([], acc), do: acc
  defp resolve_segments([".." | rest], [_ | acc_rest]), do: resolve_segments(rest, acc_rest)
  defp resolve_segments([".." | rest], []), do: resolve_segments(rest, [])
  defp resolve_segments(["." | rest], acc), do: resolve_segments(rest, acc)
  defp resolve_segments([segment | rest], acc), do: resolve_segments(rest, [segment | acc])

  defp validate_path(normalized) do
    full_path = Path.join(@base_dir, normalized)
    expanded = Path.expand(full_path)
    # Security check: ensure we stay within base directory
    if path_within_base?(expanded) do
      {:ok, expanded}
    else
      {:error, :path_traversal}
    end
  end

  # Check if the expanded path starts with the base directory
  # Uses String comparison with trailing separator for safety
  defp path_within_base?(path) do
    base_with_sep = @base_dir <> "/"
    path == @base_dir or String.starts_with?(path, base_with_sep)
  end

  defp read_file(path) do
    # Verify no symlink escape after expansion
    real_path = case System.cmd("realpath", [path], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {resolved, 0} -> String.trim(resolved)
      _ -> path
    end
    base_with_sep = @base_dir <> "/"
    unless real_path == @base_dir or String.starts_with?(real_path, base_with_sep) do
      {:error, :path_traversal}
    else
      case File.read(real_path) do
        {:ok, content} -> {:ok, content}
        {:error, _} -> {:error, :not_found}
      end
    end
  end
end

defmodule FileServer.Router do
  @moduledoc "HTTP request router for file serving"

  def handle_request(%{method: "GET", path: path, headers: headers}) do
    # Apply additional security: check for encoded traversal attempts
    if contains_traversal_pattern?(path) do
      {:error, 403, "Forbidden"}
    else
      case FileServer.serve_file(path) do
        {:ok, content} -> {:ok, 200, content}
        {:error, :path_traversal} -> {:error, 403, "Forbidden"}
        {:error, :not_found} -> {:error, 404, "Not Found"}
        {:error, _} -> {:error, 400, "Bad Request"}
      end
    end
  end

  def handle_request(_), do: {:error, 405, "Method Not Allowed"}

  defp contains_traversal_pattern?(path) do
    # Decode all percent-encoding layers then check
    decoded = fully_decode(path)
    String.contains?(decoded, "..") or String.contains?(decoded, "\\")
  end

  defp fully_decode(path) do
    decoded = URI.decode(path)
    if decoded == path, do: decoded, else: fully_decode(decoded)
  end
end

defmodule FileServer.Symlink do
  @moduledoc "Handles symbolic link resolution for aliased paths"
  @base_dir "/var/www/static"
  @aliases %{
    "docs" => "documentation",
    "img" => "images",
    "assets" => "static_assets"
  }

  def resolve_alias(path) do
    segments = String.split(path, "/", parts: 2)
    case segments do
      [first | rest] ->
        resolved_first = Map.get(@aliases, first, first)
        case rest do
          [] -> resolved_first
          [remaining] -> resolved_first <> "/" <> remaining
        end
      _ -> path
    end
  end
end

defmodule FileServer.Cache do
  @moduledoc "Simple ETS-based file cache"

  def init do
    :ets.new(:file_cache, [:named_table, :public, read_concurrency: true])
  end

  def get(path) do
    case :ets.lookup(:file_cache, path) do
      [{^path, content, timestamp}] ->
        if :os.system_time(:second) - timestamp < 300 do
          {:ok, content}
        else
          :ets.delete(:file_cache, path)
          :miss
        end
      [] -> :miss
    end
  end

  def put(path, content) do
    :ets.insert(:file_cache, {path, content, :os.system_time(:second)})
  end
end
